capabilities: sync text messages and files from Telegram chats into the vault
save messages as new notes or append them to existing notes
transcribe voice messages and video notes
apply customizable templates and set target folders for notes and files
extras: Desktop only; the README says it would never be available on mobile. Voice and video transcription requires a Telegram Premium subscription. Donations accepted.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to pull messages, files, and voice notes from Telegram chats into the vault.

relations.evidence: Transfer messages and files from Telegram to your Obsidian vault

summary: Telegram integration that syncs bot messages and files into the vault as formatted notes.
